sections.shortTitle: Suppression of Terrorist Activities Special Courts Fourth Amendment Ordinance 1996
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE CXVII OF 1996
ORDINANCE CXVII OF 1996
SUPPRESSION OF TERRORIST ACTIVITIES
(SPECIAL COURTS) (FOURTH AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 15th December, 1996]
No. F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 15‑12‑1996.‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) Act, 1975 (XV of
1975), for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which
render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance, namely:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Suppression of Terrorist Activities (Special Courts) (Fourth
Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
